# libgomp.so.1 is the cross compiler's own (Ubuntu's gcc-13-cross 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1,
# built from gcc-13_13.3.0.orig.tar.gz above); libpulse-simple.so.0 is ChaOS's
# res/ports/libpack/pulse-simple.c; Ogg comes from dist/brick/portlibs-source.tar.xz.
